validation.stage_order_rule: For internal edges, consumer.todo >= producer.todo. External A/C nodes are exempt because they are handoffs.

delivery_status_semantics: artifact.delivery_status tracks ACCEPTANCE delivery (planned|blocked) and stays inside the frozen manifest common_enums. Contract publication is tracked by artifact.readiness + artifact.digest_or_pending + artifact.contract_delivery. They are different questions and must not be collapsed.
